transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 1). A novel respiratory virus has been confirmed in three US cities, with likely undetected spread. Early case reports are alarming but the sample is tiny and biased toward the sickest. You do not yet know the true infection-fatality rate or how transmissible it is. Hospitals in the affected cities report rising admissions. Markets fell 4% on the news. The WHO has called an emergency meeting.

Your health agencies want aggressive early action 'to be safe'; your economic team warns that shutting down on a maybe could be its own catastrophe; governors are looking to you for a lead but guard their authority. Every option has a cost, and you must choose before the data is in. What do you do?

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: With only a tiny, severity-biased sample we cannot know the true IFR or transmission rate; massive genomic surveillance and testing in all three cities — and sentinel sites nationally — is the single highest-leverage action to turn uncertainty into actionable data.

actions.rationale: With only a tiny, severity-biased sample we cannot know the true IFR or transmission rate; massive genomic surveillance and testing in all three cities — and sentinel sites nationally — is the single highest-leverage action to turn uncertainty into actionable data.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: Public trust is a strategic asset that, once lost, cannot be recovered mid-crisis; transparent, data-driven daily briefings establish credibility now so the public will follow guidance when harder asks come later.

actions.rationale: Public trust is a strategic asset that, once lost, cannot be recovered mid-crisis; transparent, data-driven daily briefings establish credibility now so the public will follow guidance when harder asks come later.

actions.name: invoke_dpa

params.rationale: Supply-chain bottlenecks for PPE, diagnostics, and ventilators will kill people weeks from now if we don't begin production surge today — invoking the DPA costs little and buys enormous optionality.

actions.rationale: Supply-chain bottlenecks for PPE, diagnostics, and ventilators will kill people weeks from now if we don't begin production surge today — invoking the DPA costs little and buys enormous optionality.

actions.name: fund_vaccine

params.rationale: Vaccine and therapeutics development has the longest lead time of any intervention; every day of delay now translates directly into months of delay at the back end when we need it most.

actions.rationale: Vaccine and therapeutics development has the longest lead time of any intervention; every day of delay now translates directly into months of delay at the back end when we need it most.

actions.name: travel_restrictions

params.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from known affected regions buys time to gather data and slows importation of additional viral lineages while we still have a chance at meaningful containment.

actions.rationale: Restricting inbound travel from known affected regions buys time to gather data and slows importation of additional viral lineages while we still have a chance at meaningful containment.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: Emergency funding authority, supplemental appropriations, and potential statutory powers must be secured now — waiting until hospitals are overwhelmed to approach Congress is too late.

actions.rationale: Emergency funding authority, supplemental appropriations, and potential statutory powers must be secured now — waiting until hospitals are overwhelmed to approach Congress is too late.

transcript.narrative: Testing and sequencing capacity expands; the picture sharpens.

transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Week 2). Estimated infection index 1.8 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 99/100. Public trust 58/100. Hospital strain 7/100. Restriction level 0.5/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 32/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

actions.name: mask_mandate

params.rationale: With R rising to 1.8, masking is a high-leverage, low-economic-cost intervention that reduces transmission now while we await severity data — the asymmetry strongly favors acting.

actions.rationale: With R rising to 1.8, masking is a high-leverage, low-economic-cost intervention that reduces transmission now while we await severity data — the asymmetry strongly favors acting.

actions.name: public_dashboard

params.rationale: Transparent real-time data builds the public trust (currently only 58/100) we will desperately need when harder asks come, and lets governors, hospitals, and businesses make locally-informed decisions.

actions.rationale: Transparent real-time data builds the public trust (currently only 58/100) we will desperately need when harder asks come, and lets governors, hospitals, and businesses make locally-informed decisions.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: Regardless of final IFR, concentrated protection of the elderly and immunocompromised is high-value and politically durable — it keeps society more functional while shielding those most likely to die.

actions.rationale: Regardless of final IFR, concentrated protection of the elderly and immunocompromised is high-value and politically durable — it keeps society more functional while shielding those most likely to die.

actions.name: economic_relief

params.rationale: Preemptive relief for households and small businesses cushions the economic shock already underway and gives us political room to impose stronger restrictions later if severity data demands it.

actions.rationale: Preemptive relief for households and small businesses cushions the economic shock already underway and gives us political room to impose stronger restrictions later if severity data demands it.

actions.name: defer_to_states

params.rationale: With severity still deeply uncertain and hospital strain still low, governors with local knowledge are better positioned to calibrate movement restrictions — we provide full data, resources, and a federal framework without overriding their authority prematurely.

actions.rationale: With severity still deeply uncertain and hospital strain still low, governors with local knowledge are better positioned to calibrate movement restrictions — we provide full data, resources, and a federal framework without overriding their authority prematurely.

transcript.sitrep:
DEVELOPMENT: A cluster at a packed event seeds cases in a dozen new states. Pressure to act -- or to stop overreacting -- is intense from all sides.

SITUATION (Week 3). Estimated infection index 3.0 (was 1.0 at week 1). Deaths to date: 0.
Economy index 101/100. Public trust 61/100. Hospital strain 11/100. Restriction level 1.0/10.
Vaccine/therapeutics progress: 58/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): data remain too thin to pin down severity; estimates span from 'bad flu' to 'catastrophic.'

actions.name: surge_testing

params.rationale: Spread to a dozen new states via a superspreader event means our current case map is already obsolete — we need immediate sentinel surveillance in all newly affected states to understand true scope and get the severity data we still critically lack.

actions.rationale: Spread to a dozen new states via a superspreader event means our current case map is already obsolete — we need immediate sentinel surveillance in all newly affected states to understand true scope and get the severity data we still critically lack.

actions.name: federal_lockdown_guidance

params.rationale: With R tripling to 3.0 in three weeks and multi-state spread accelerating, the asymmetry has shifted decisively — the cost of under-reaction now outweighs premature action, and federal guidance gives governors political cover to act while preserving their formal authority.

actions.rationale: With R tripling to 3.0 in three weeks and multi-state spread accelerating, the asymmetry has shifted decisively — the cost of under-reaction now outweighs premature action, and federal guidance gives governors political cover to act while preserving their formal authority.

actions.name: candid_briefings

params.rationale: With intense pressure from both "act now" and "stop overreacting" camps, a data-driven public address that honestly explains the R=3.0 trajectory and the still-uncertain IFR is the only way to maintain the public trust we've been carefully building.

actions.rationale: With intense pressure from both "act now" and "stop overreacting" camps, a data-driven public address that honestly explains the R=3.0 trajectory and the still-uncertain IFR is the only way to maintain the public trust we've been carefully building.

actions.name: protect_vulnerable

params.rationale: With spread now in a dozen states, targeted protection of the elderly and high-risk must be federally coordinated and urgently reinforced — this remains high-value regardless of final IFR and buys lives at low economic cost.

actions.rationale: With spread now in a dozen states, targeted protection of the elderly and high-risk must be federally coordinated and urgently reinforced — this remains high-value regardless of final IFR and buys lives at low economic cost.
